metadata._description: Updates the Basewiser portal Container App image. Existing configuration (env vars, scaling, ingress, secrets) is preserved via union(reference(...)) — only the container image is bumped. The backend Function App is updated through a separate flow (Kudu zip-deploy), not this template. Linked from the in-portal update banner via a portal.azure.com Custom Deployment deeplink.

metadata.description: Container App hosting the Basewiser portal (e.g. mssp-portal-14e12458).
Full image reference for the new portal version (e.g. ghcr.io/basewiser/portal:v20260520.123456).

resources.comments: Portal Container App — image bump. union(reference(...)) merges so env vars, scaling, ingress and secrets are preserved.
resources.name: [parameters('portalAppName')]
resources.properties: [union(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.App/containerApps', parameters('portalAppName')), variables('caApiVersion'), 'Full').properties, createObject('template', union(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.App/containerApps', parameters('portalAppName')), variables('caApiVersion'), 'Full').properties.template, createObject('containers', createArray(union(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.App/containerApps', parameters('portalAppName')), variables('caApiVersion'), 'Full').properties.template.containers[0], createObject('image', parameters('portalImage'))))))))]
